tools.name: kbo_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Belgian company by its KBO/BCE enterprise number (10 digits, e.g. 0403.170.701). Returns the official name, status, legal form and start date from the public KBO register, with the source URL.

tools.name: vies_validate
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number against the official EU VIES service. Returns validity plus, where the member state exposes it, the registered trade name and address. Example: BE0403170701.

vat.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. BE0403170701.
vat.title: Vat

tools.name: ecli_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a Belgian ECLI (European Case Law Identifier) to canonical public lookup URLs (EU e-Justice + Juportal) plus court metadata. Example: ECLI:BE:CASS:2020:ARR.20200101.1.

tools.name: eurlex_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an EU CELEX number to its canonical EUR-Lex landing URL plus metadata (sector, document type). Example: 32016R0679 (GDPR).

tools.name: erfbelasting_tarieven
tools.description: Flemish inheritance-tax (erfbelasting) rate brackets, parsed deterministically from the in-force Flemish Tax Code (VCF art. 2.7.4.1.1) — for ALL heir categories: direct line & partners, siblings, and others. Omit `categorie` to get all three. Use this instead of reciting rates from memory.

categorie.description: Heir category: rechte_lijn_partners, broers_zussen or anderen. Omit for all three.
categorie.title: Categorie

tools.name: legal_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a Belgian legislation reference to its canonical Justel URL. Give the code (BW, WVV, WIB92, VCF, WBTW, WBE, Sw, Ger.W) and optionally the article number. Example: code=BW, article=4.71.

code.description: Belgian legal code, e.g. BW, WVV, WIB92, VCF.
code.title: Code

tools.name: legal_search
tools.description: Keyword-search Belgian legislation on Justel and return a search URL plus relevant code hints. Use when you don't know the exact reference.

tools.name: legal_read
tools.description: Fetch and clean the full text of an official Belgian or European legal document (HTML or PDF) from a URL on the allowlist of official sources (e.g. ejustice.just.fgov.be, eur-lex.europa.eu). Capped at 30,000 characters. Pair with legal_lookup / eurlex_lookup to get the URL first.

url.description: Document URL on an allowed official domain.
url.title: Url

tools.name: nl_legal_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a Dutch statute reference to its wetten.overheid.nl URL. Give the code (BW4, Successiewet, Wet IB 2001, Wet OB 1968, BW6, Awb, Sr, Rv) and optionally an article. Example: code=BW4, article=4:63.

code.description: Dutch statute short-form, e.g. BW4, Successiewet, Wet IB 2001.
code.title: Code

tools.name: nl_rechtspraak_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a Dutch ECLI to canonical case-law URLs (Rechtspraak.nl details, the free Open Data content API, and EU e-Justice). Example: ECLI:NL:HR:2021:1102.

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: Validate an IBAN's structure (ISO 13616 check digits via MOD-97 + country length). Pure compute; confirms well-formedness, not that the account exists or is active.

iban.description: An IBAN, with or without spaces.
iban.title: Iban

tools.name: ecb_rates
tools.description: Return the official daily ECB euro reference rate 1 EUR = X currency for a given ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, GBP, CHF).

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, GBP, CHF.
currency.title: Currency
